15% Success Advisory Fee

Payable Only Upon Actual Recovery

We charge zero upfront percentage commissions. You pay our success advisory fee only when the disputed settlement funds have been credited to your bank account.

  • check_circle Incremental Calculation: Applied strictly to the additional money actually recovered via ClaimSathi’s intervention, never on what the insurer already sanctioned.
  • check_circle Tranche Protection: If the insurer pays in separate tranches or installments, our fee applies strictly proportionately as each payment settles.
  • check_circle Automatic Advance Offset: Your ₹4,500 advance is deducted directly from the calculated 15% invoice, leaving only the net delta payable.

Clear Refund & Protection Framework

No ambiguities, no fine print surprises. We outline precise outcomes for every scenario before you pay a single rupee.

assignment_turned_in

Case Declined After Scrutiny

If, following our ₹500 deep-dive analysis, our legal experts conclude that the insurer’s repudiation was legally sound or that mandatory evidentiary records are absent, we will honestly decline the case. The remaining ₹4,500 advance is immediately refunded.

Zero Recovery Guarantee

For all accepted disputes that yield zero incremental financial recovery despite completing internal insurer grievances and the relevant Insurance Ombudsman filings, the ₹4,500 advance is credited back to your account within 30 working days.

Client Withdrawal Terms

Should you decide to voluntarily withdraw your case after case acceptance, strategy drafting, or active insurer submission, the initial ₹5,000 retainer is retained to defray operational, legal drafting, and forensic resources invested to that point.

Litigation & Advocate Costs

Our core advisory covers Grievance Desks and Insurance Ombudsman forums. If a claim requires escalation to Consumer Forums, State Commissions, or Civil Courts, policyholders must engage independent advocates with separate statutory filing fees.

Zero Pre-payment of Commissions

We only invoice our 15% recovery commission after insurer disbursement is confirmed.

2
Advance Credited In Full

3
Direct Bank Receipt

The insurer transfers 100% of the funds directly to you. We never intermediate claim funds.

Why We Don't Offer 'Free' Ingestion

The Rationale Behind Our ₹500 Scrutiny Retainer

Mass-market aggregators promise '100% free claim processing' only to leave rejected cases neglected in automated queues when an insurer resists. We reject that volume playbook.

Our modest ₹500 scrutiny fee guarantees that a qualified former insurance underwriter and advocate meticulously reads every word of your policy schedule, exclusions clause, and hospital records. If there is no legitimate legal route to recovery, we will inform you frankly, preventing months of false hope and wasted legal expenditure.

Clarity at Every Step

Frequently Asked Questions on Fees

Transparent answers to common queries regarding retainer accounts, success thresholds, and dispute refund handling.

The 15% success fee becomes due strictly after the disputed claim amount has been successfully settled and credited into your registered bank account by the insurance company. We raise an official tax invoice upon settlement verification, from which your ₹4,500 advance deposit is automatically subtracted.

Our 15% fee applies strictly to the incremental funds actually credited to you through our representation. If your dispute was for ₹5,00,000 and we successfully recover ₹2,50,000, our fee is calculated exclusively on ₹2,50,000 (i.e. ₹37,500, less your ₹4,500 advance). If the insurer releases payments in multiple tranches, our fees are billed strictly on a proportionate basis as each amount arrives.

If an accepted case results in zero financial recovery despite exhausting grievance representation and Ombudsman hearings, our Finance Custodian issues a refund of the ₹4,500 advance directly to your original bank account within 30 working days of formal closure. The ₹500 fee is retained to cover third-party statutory and administrative file scrutiny costs.

No. By law and per our ethical operating charter, insurance companies disburse claim amounts solely to the primary policyholder or legal beneficiary's verified bank account. We never handle or intercept your insurance payout. Once you receive your settlement credit, you settle our invoice via verified bank transfer.

Our standard mandate encompasses insurer internal representations, regulatory grievance management, and Insurance Ombudsman petition drafting and advocacy. If a case must proceed to judicial litigation (Consumer Disputes Redressal Commission or Civil Courts), this requires an independent legal practitioner with court stamp duties, counsel appearance retainers, and filing costs agreed separately.
